integrity: The proof reconstructs the source's preconditional axioms and derived consequent monotonicity, derives idempotent row ceiling maps, translates importation exactly into cross-row fixed-point compatibility, and then specializes conditional identity and semicomplementation. A bundled checker exhausts all raw operations through three elements and independently enumerates the normal form through eight elements.
scientific_limitations: The factorial formula is specific to finite chains and the T/F algebraic axioms of the source. The unrestricted K normal form is complete, but no closed formula for its total count is claimed. No decision-complexity improvement or classification of relational representations is asserted.
title: Fixed-point normal form for finite-chain preconditionals
